# See whether that offer still beats eBay.

> See what a Reverb sale leaves after fees, shipping and gear cost, and whether to take an offer, consign, take a shop cash offer or accept a partial refund.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
